rubric: Evaluate the contract from the public request, issue-time decisions, and contemporaneous observable behavior. Require only supported externally observable outcomes, including preservation of compatible behavior. Treat implementation structure, algorithms, representations, internal helper results, validation mechanisms, diagnostics, messages, documentation, refactors, and test organization or fixtures as incidental unless explicitly required. Later patches and tests may diagnose the defect, demonstrate outcomes, identify affected input classes or public paths, and provide non-regression evidence; they do not retroactively require the chosen fix, exact examples, private-state assertions, broader unrequested coverage, or hindsight-optimal choices. Penalize missing supported outcomes, unsupported scope expansion, and compatibility regressions; accept any implementation that satisfies the evidence-backed observable contract.
